text: I am facing land issue among my own family. My brother is claiming that the land belongs to him where he has fake documentation. But the land actually belongs to me and I have the original documents. What should i do?

My brother is claiming ownership of a piece of land that I believe belongs to me. I have the original property documents in my possession, but my brother is relying on documents that I believe may be forged. I want to establish the legal ownership of the land and prevent any unauthorised sale or transfer.
After my grandfather died, my uncles divided the farmland among themselves and left out my mother completely. They say daughters have no right.
Our neighbour has started construction and his compound wall is now about three feet into our plot. When we objected he said the land is his.
My cousin secretly sold the ancestral house to a builder without informing any of us. We all have equal shares in that house.
The survey stones between my field and the next field were shifted during the night and now the neighbour says that strip belongs to him.
I would like to understand my options. A person I know assaulted me in the market two days ago and I had to get four stitches on my forehead.
Someone snatched my gold chain while I was walking home from the temple yesterday evening.
A man promised to get my son a government job and took three lakh rupees from us. Now his phone is switched off and there is no job.
I went to the police station to report that my shop was broken into, but the inspector refused to register an FIR and told me to settle it outside.
My landlord's son keeps threatening that he will kill me if I don't pay him fifty thousand rupees.
I want a divorce. My husband humiliates me in front of everyone and we have been living separately for a year.
My husband left us two years ago and does not pay anything for me or our two children, even though he runs a business.
My husband drinks and beats me almost every night. I am scared to stay in the house.
My in-laws keep demanding a car and five lakh rupees from my parents and they torture me because my father cannot pay.
My ex-wife has taken our 4-year-old son to her parents' place and does not allow me to meet him.
I clicked on a link in an SMS about my KYC and entered my net banking password. Then 60,000 rupees were transferred out of my account.
A caller said he was from the electricity board and made me scan a QR code. 12,000 rupees went from my UPI account.
Someone has opened an Instagram account with my name and photos and is messaging my followers asking for money.
A man from my old office messages me every day from new numbers even after I blocked him, and he comments about where I go.
My former boyfriend has edited my photos into obscene pictures and says he will send them to my family.
The laptop I purchased last month stopped working and the store refuses to repair it under warranty.
I paid for a one-year broadband plan but the connection has not worked for a month and the company does not respond to complaints.
There are three debit card transactions in my statement that I did not make and the bank says it cannot help.
I returned a phone within the return period and the pickup was done, but the website is not giving my refund.
Recovery agents from a loan app call me many times a day, abuse me and have messaged my relatives that I am a thief.
ನನ್ನ ಅಣ್ಣ ನಕಲಿ ದಾಖಲೆ ಮಾಡಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಜಮೀನು ತನ್ನದು ಅಂತಿದ್ದಾನೆ, ಆದರೆ ಮೂಲ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು ನನ್ನ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಇವೆ.
ಅಪ್ಪ ತೀರಿಕೊಂಡ ಮೇಲೆ ನನ್ನ ಅಣ್ಣಂದಿರು ನನಗೆ ಆಸ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಲು ಕೊಡ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಪಾಲು ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂತಾರೆ.
ನನ್ನ ಗಂಡ ಆರು ತಿಂಗಳಿಂದ ಮನೆ ಖರ್ಚಿಗೆ ಹಣ ಕೊಡ್ತಿಲ್ಲ, ನನಗೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಇಲ್ಲ.
ಯಾರೋ ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರಲ್ಲಿ ನಕಲಿ ಫೇಸ್‌ಬುಕ್ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಹತ್ತಿರ ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೇಳ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
ಹೊಸ ವಾಷಿಂಗ್ ಮಷೀನ್ ಒಂದು ತಿಂಗಳಲ್ಲೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡೋದು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿತು, ಅಂಗಡಿಯವರು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
ನಿನ್ನೆ ಸಂಜೆ ಬಸ್ ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನ ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಕದ್ದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋದರು.
मेरे भाई ने नकली कागज़ बनाकर हमारी ज़मीन अपने नाम करने की कोशिश की है, असली कागज़ मेरे पास हैं।
पड़ोसी ने हमारे प्लॉट में तीन फ़ुट अंदर दीवार बना ली है और हटाने से मना करता है।
मेरे पति और सास दहेज के लिए मुझे रोज़ परेशान करते हैं और मारते भी हैं।
किसी ने बैंक कर्मचारी बनकर फ़ोन किया और ओटीपी पूछकर मेरे खाते से चालीस हज़ार निकाल लिए।
एक आदमी ने विदेश में नौकरी दिलाने के नाम पर मुझसे दो लाख रुपये ले लिए और अब फ़ोन नहीं उठाता।
Mera beta meri patni ke paas hai aur woh mujhe usse milne nahi deti.
Loan app avru dina call maadi baitaare, nanna contacts ge ella message kalisiddaare.
Please advise. A property dispute has arisen with my sibling, who has produced a will that I believe is not genuine, in order to claim our late mother's house.
